rationale: The exact decision's provisional NO recommendation is supported within the supplied source perimeter. EO 13991 §§1–8, 86 FR 7045–7048 (PDF pp.1–4). Sections 2–3 require federal workplace precautions, guidance, exceptions/safeguards, regular updates and wider masking support; §4 establishes the Safer Federal Workforce Task Force with ongoing guidance and agency cooperation; §§5–6 require testing/research work; §7(b) requires interbranch consultation/technical assistance. Revocation must cover this whole package, not just masks. EO 14122 §2, 89 FR 27355 (PDF p.1), explicitly revokes EO 13991 as a whole. Section 3 transfers COVID Response Coordinator duties and terminates the specified coordinator positions created by EO 13987; it does not state that EO 13991's Task Force or other commands survive §2. EO 13991's §2(d) exceptions, §7 scope and §8 general provisions restrict implementation or preserve independent legal authority, not a surviving command regime. EO 14122 §4 likewise contains no target-order reservation. Historical guidance, agency powers and accrued safety measures do not demonstrate continuing EO 13991 obligations. EO 14148's full §2 list does not include EO 14122. Its rescissions of other pandemic orders do not revive EO 13991, and no affirmative re-enactment appears in its full text.
